concerns.text: Phase 6 (Scaling Law Analysis, Tasks T070-T074) implements a 'Scaling Law Analysis' based on simulated reviewer feedback, but this feature is entirely absent from spec.md (which limits scope to FR-001–FR-009 regarding PSM/DiD). There is no matching FR, SC, or plan element for these tasks, creating unapproved scope creep and implementation waste.

Task T044 (Security hardening/PII scanner) is marked as failed/rejected due to missing artifacts (no `github/workflows/ci.yml` defined in plan.md). The Constitution (Principle III) mandates PII scanning, but there is no corresponding task in the plan or spec to define the CI workflow structure required to satisfy this constitutional requirement.

Tasks T070-T074 reference 'Geoffrey West simulated reviewer feedback' and 'metabolic flux' scaling laws. These concepts do not exist in the current spec.md or plan.md. These tags are stale references to an external simulation not yet integrated into the project's formal requirements.
